svg.title: KAY CRM MCD
svg.desc: Conceptual relationships and participation cardinalities, split into seven business domains.
svg.text: Business entities, reusable inventory hierarchy and relationship cardinalities.
Documented target model / implementation is partial

g.text: A single protected client identity can generate several enquiries and deals.
Primary responsibility is singular; collaborators are an explicit many-to-many relation.
Roles such as buyer, tenant, owner and developer belong to the contact.
Villa, house, apartment and land can be standalone assets or actual units.
Block/floor are optional outside apartment developments; a type is never stock.
Each unit is distinct. Reusing a type never shares its price or reservation.
Customer proposals, reservation, closing and collection are different facts.
Acceptance is not a deal close
Offering target is a physical property OR an entire development, never both.
Only one active hold per offering; full reservation history may contain many.
Independent searches, exact offerings and actions attributed to their real author.
Required and preferred criteria are distinct; unknown is not zero.
Shortlists are many-to-many associations resolved into a link table in the MLD.
Three visit types share a calendar; only company-car visits consume capacity.
Company car / no company car / office
Office visits bypass working windows and capacity. Both off-site types follow hours.
Policy is versioned; company-car capacity starts at two agency-wide per local hour.

g.data-domain: Protected documents and scoped file access
g.text: Protected documents and scoped file access
Shared inventory documents and private owner evidence must remain separate.
Private object, hash, MIME and size
Document belongs to exactly one of four typed parents; each parent link is optional.
A permit is tied to a session, action and real resource; no public file URLs.
Validate first, commit all eligible contacts atomically and protect retries.
Agent per row and validation errors
Existing phone identities are skipped and reported; no partial accepted batch.
Website receipts create enquiries, never expose contact existence to the form.
Entities and business relationships, not SQL tables.
Cardinalities use Merise participation at each end:
1..N one or more 0..N zero or more
A contact may have many enquiries;
each enquiry belongs to exactly one contact.
The same name in another panel is the same entity.
XOR means one parent/target, never several.
Join tables, rate buckets and command receipts
are resolved in the logical model (MLD).
Known positive price + legal owner before availability.
Private owner documents never become shared inventory.
Whole-project and child-unit commitments are checked.

svg.text: Participation: 1..1 required single / 0..1 optional / 1..N one or more / 0..N any number.
Source: docs/04-design/data-model.md + current identity/contact ORM + documented business rules.
Diagram styling: user-approved KAY ivory / charcoal / gold. No credentials, client records or live database data.
